messages.subject: Warning message?
parts:

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Warning message?
parts:
On 01/12/2015 11:42 PM, Aiden loe wrote:
> I was wondering what does it mean? Thank you.

> 1: In pc_cor_TS(fit.y1 = FIT[[i]], fit.y2 = FIT[[j]], method =
> optim.method, :
> lavaan WARNING: empty cell(s) in bivariate table of SHS2 x SHS1

If you construct a crosstable (a frequency table) of SHS2 x SHS1, then
you will see that you have empty cells. This often happens when the
sample size is small.

This is not necessarily problematic, but you should be aware of it.

Yves.
